description: Non-traditional data sources for alpha generation including satellite imagery, web scraping, credit card data, geolocation, IoT sensors, and social media signals.

techniques.name: Satellite Imagery Analysis
techniques.description: Computer vision (CNNs) applied to satellite images to count retail parking lot cars, monitor crop yields, and track oil storage levels. Commercial providers include Orbital Insight and RS Metrics.
techniques.verification_notes: Orbital Insight and RS Metrics are established alternative data providers. Satellite-based alpha strategies documented in academic literature.

techniques.name: Credit Card Transaction Data
techniques.description: Aggregated anonymized credit card data provides real-time revenue estimates 30-60 days before earnings reports. Providers include Second Measure and Earnest Research.
techniques.verification_notes: Second Measure acquired by Bloomberg in 2020. Transaction data for revenue nowcasting is well-established.

techniques.name: Web Scraping Pipelines
techniques.description: Automated scraping of job postings, product reviews, pricing data, and other web sources for leading indicators of company performance.
techniques.verification_notes: Web scraping for alternative data is widely practiced. Regulatory considerations (GDPR, CCPA, CFAA) must be addressed.

techniques.name: Geolocation Foot Traffic Analysis
techniques.description: Mobile device geolocation data tracking foot traffic to retail locations, providing real-time demand indicators before earnings announcements.
techniques.verification_notes: Foot traffic data providers verified. Alpha from foot traffic is documented but decaying as adoption increases.

techniques.name: ESG NLP Scoring
techniques.description: NLP analysis of sustainability reports, news, and regulatory filings to generate ESG scores. Growing importance for institutional investors with ESG mandates.
techniques.verification_notes: ESG-NLP is an active research area. Commercial ESG scoring is a multi-billion dollar industry.

techniques.name: Supply Chain & Shipping Data
techniques.description: Container tracking, port activity monitoring, and supply chain disruption signals provide macro-economic leading indicators.
techniques.verification_notes: Supply chain data for macro signals is well-documented. Alt data market size corrected to $11-18B (2024) per Team 3 verification (original $7B figure was outdated).
